summary: Start room = climb + 15-u-wide TIGHTROPE over a kill layer + drop. All plain PPO arms stall at ~250 u (0.45%). Built: --view-ent-squash (yaw sigma 2.72 -> ~1.0), Go-Explore energy cells (--cell-energy; the search leaves the room in <1 min, reaches 3.8%), --spawn-states-curric (Florensa reverse curriculum over the search's states). Phase 2 (train from the search's chains) taught the policy everything downstream of the tightrope's west end, but not the tightrope middle or the climb: greedy evals stay at ~250 u. Now: pbr1b3_gx4 = resume with a local curriculum threshold (G 0.003 x d0) and 70% spawns from the search states. Best eval 0.454 (gx3 @605M, 266 u).
